suite: API tests with a mocked AI provider (no network, no key)

cases.name: GET reports configuration honestly, without exposing the key
Missing API key → 503 AI_NOT_CONFIGURED (never pretends the model ran)
Valid model output is validated and returned with mode "ai"
Fabricated amounts from the model are removed by deterministic checks
Invalid JSON, timeouts, rate limits and upstream errors fail safely
Anthropic provider (optional) uses forced tool output
Mocked provider: Devanagari message, prompt injection and hallucinated claim amounts
Mocked provider: body over the size limit and wrong types are rejected before any call
ask: GET reports configuration without exposing the key
ask: no key → 503 AI_NOT_CONFIGURED, so the page uses its rule-based answer
ask: invalid requests are rejected before any provider call
ask: model output is cleaned (allowed actions only, length capped) and never changes state
ask: provider timeout → 504 with an honest message
ask: an answer that cites rupee amounts not in the data is discarded (502 UNSUPPORTED_AMOUNT)
ask: 429 and 5xx from the provider are reported, never answered
ask: per-IP rate limit (in-memory, best-effort per instance)
